nodes.label: ERP Procurement Multi-Agent System
nodes.source_location: ERP procurement project, extracted text lines 223–362
nodes.rationale: Resume describes DeepAgents and LangGraph orchestration, isolated subagent contexts, sandbox execution, persistent memory, and two-stage human approval.

nodes.label: Harness Sandbox Memory Routing
nodes.rationale: Uses OpenSandbox for execution isolation and CompositeBackend routing for persistent memories and skills in MongoDB; progressive skill loading and combined MCP tools reduce context overhead.

nodes.label: Multimodal RAG Retrieval
nodes.source_location: multimodal knowledge base project, extracted text lines 363–517
nodes.rationale: Describes aligned text/image embeddings, Dots.OCR parsing, semantic chunking, Milvus dense and sparse indexes, short-term Redis memory, and long-term vector memory.

nodes.label: Corrective Adaptive RAG Evaluation
nodes.source_location: multimodal project sections 5–6; medical project section 5
nodes.rationale: RAGAS evaluates retrieval and answer quality; failed retrieval can trigger another search or query rewriting, while persistent low confidence leads to human review.

nodes.label: Medical Document RAG System
nodes.source_location: medical document knowledge base project, extracted text lines 518–635
nodes.rationale: Resume describes PyMuPDF and UnstructuredLoader parsing, OCR, SemanticChunker, bge embeddings, BM25, Milvus, and intent-driven routing among specialized knowledge sources.

nodes.label: Financial Agent Human Approval
nodes.source_location: financial assistant project, extracted text lines 636–756
nodes.rationale: Separates read-only and sensitive financial tools, interrupts before sensitive actions, and persists workflow state in PostgreSQL for continued execution after approval.
